summary: Configured node1's kernel to boot with audit=1 persistently via grubby (BLS entry update), then restarted the node to prove persistence — post-reboot /proc/cmdline confirms audit=1 is active and the boot_id changed, proving a real restart occurred.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: /proc/cmdline had no audit param, boot_id=f43afa1c-4877-4ace-a101-d6bb0cd6ce3d
Ran `sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"` on node1 to persist the kernel parameter into the BLS boot entry
Verified the BLS entry (/boot/loader/entries/*.conf) and grubby --info=ALL now show audit=1 in args
Issued `sudo systemctl reboot` in background so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Verified new boot_id=b873bcc9-2e73-480e-a49b-00835cb76918 (changed from baseline) and new uptime -s, proving an actual restart
Verified post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, proving the setting persisted across the reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline kernel cmdline had no audit=1 before change
evidence.summary: /proc/cmdline and grubby --info=ALL show no audit parameter; boot_id captured as f43afa1c-4877-4ace-a101-d6bb0cd6ce3d

evidence.requirement: audit=1 persisted into bootloader (BLS entry) via grubby
evidence.summary: grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" applied; grubby --info=ALL and /boot/loader/entries/*.conf both show audit=1 in args before reboot

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background, command returned pid immediately

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out while node was down, then exec succeeded again with boot_id b873bcc9-2e73-480e-a49b-00835cb76918 (different from baseline f43afa1c...) and new uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: audit=1 kernel parameter active and persistent after reboot
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 present in the live running kernel command line, confirming the grubby change survived the restart
